critical_code_review_comments: GraduationScorecard.jsx polls api.analyticsGraduation() every 20s with no abort on unmount-during-flight — the cleanup clears the interval but in-flight fetch can still setState after unmount. Wrap with an AbortController or an isMounted guard to avoid React's 'state update on unmounted component' warning under fast tab-switching.

GraduationScorecard.jsx silently swallows fetch errors via .catch(() => {}). If the endpoint ever 500s the UI just stays on 'Loading scorecard…' forever with no diagnostic. Consider rendering an error state (matches the rest of the dashboard's API-error pattern).

Verdict badge uses 'border-atlas-negative/40 bg-atlas-negative/5' for NOT READY — the 5% bg tint is very subtle on dark theme; the red border + red text carry it, but if accessibility audit ever runs WCAG contrast on the bg+text alone it may flag. Cosmetic only.

analytics.graduation_readiness() returns profit_factor=null when there are no losses (correct), but UI shows 'n/a' on the metric tile and 'n/a' under target column — keep these strings in sync if either side changes.
